title: Five for Five in Houston
dek: In Houston, UConn smothered San Diego State 76-59 for its fifth national title: five wins in five title games, and six tournament wins, all by double digits.

facts.tip: 9:20 p.m. ET (8:20 p.m. CT local), scheduled

setup.text: UConn began 2022-23 outside the AP Top 25, listed only among 'others receiving votes.' Dan Hurley had gone to the transfer portal for shooters after two straight first-round NCAA exits.

The Huskies won their first 14 games and climbed to No. 2, then lost six of eight between Dec. 31 and Jan. 25. They entered the tournament as the West's No. 4 seed, a program without an NCAA tournament win since 2016.
Then nobody came close. Iona, Saint Mary's, Arkansas and Gonzaga fell by 24, 15, 23 and 28 points, sending UConn to its first Final Four in nine years, and Miami fell by 13 in the national semifinal.

San Diego State, the South's No. 5 seed, had never been past the Sweet 16 before this run. It beat top-seeded Alabama, edged Creighton 57-56 and rallied from 14 down to beat Florida Atlantic 72-71 on Lamont Butler's buzzer-beater, in the first Final Four without a top-three seed. It was also Jim Nantz's last game calling the tournament for CBS, ending a 37-year run.

story.text: The Aztecs made four of their first six shots and led 10-6. Then they went 11 minutes and 7 seconds without a field goal, missing 14 straight, and fell behind by as many as 12.

UConn did it the old-fashioned way. Its first 3-pointer did not come until more than 13 minutes in; until then the Huskies kept skip-passing the ball into Adama Sanogo in the post and built the lead two points at a time.
Jordan Hawkins, Tristen Newton and Joey Calcaterra then hit 3s within a few minutes of each other, and Calcaterra's made it 36-20. UConn took a 36-24 lead to halftime.

sequence.text: Sanogo scores inside off an Andre Jackson Jr. feed, part of a 10-0 run that turns a 10-6 deficit into a 16-10 lead. UConn never trails, or is tied, again.
Hawkins hits UConn's first 3-pointer of the night, more than 13 minutes in. San Diego State still has no field goal since 16:32.
Darrion Trammell's jumper finally ends the Aztecs' drought, after 14 straight misses.
Calcaterra's 3, set up by Jackson, pushes the lead back to 16, matching the half's biggest margin, first reached on Newton's 3 at 4:12.
Calcaterra connects again, this time on a pass from Donovan Clingan. UConn leads by 15 with under 10 minutes left.
Trammell steals the ball and scores, capping a 9-0 Aztecs burst built on two Jaedon LeDee baskets and a Keshad Johnson 3.
Johnson makes two free throws. A 14-4 San Diego State run has cut the lead to five, the closest the game has been since 16-12 in the first half.
Hawkins answers on the next trip with a 3 off a Newton pass. It starts a 9-0 UConn run.
Newton, who goes 8-for-8 from the line on the night, makes two more free throws.
Newton scores again. The lead is back to 12.
Sanogo grabs two offensive rebounds on one possession, draws a foul and makes both free throws to finish the 9-0 run.
Jackson splits a pair of free throws for UConn's last point. The 17-point margin holds to the horn.

quotes.text: We knew we were the best team in the tournament going in, and we just had to play to our level.
We weren't ranked going into the year, so we had the chip on our shoulder.
We had to be at our best. We weren't at our best.
After he watched our practice, he was like, 'I see that I can count on you guys, you guys are a special team.'
quotes.role: UConn forward, Final Four Most Outstanding Player
quotes.when: postgame, April 3, 2023, recalling a preseason visit from Emeka Okafor

aftermath.text: Sanogo was named the Final Four's Most Outstanding Player after averaging 19.7 points and 9.8 rebounds across the six games. Hurley became the third coach to win a title at UConn, after Jim Calhoun and Kevin Ollie.
The win made UConn 5-0 in national championship games, and four of those five titles had been won in Texas.
On May 26, 2023, President Joe Biden hosted the team at the White House, where captains Jackson and Sanogo presented him with a commemorative jersey.
The roster turned over quickly: by the next April, UConn's top two scorers from this team were playing in the NBA. The Huskies won the 2024 title anyway.

legacy.text: CBS Sports calculated that UConn was the first team ever to win six NCAA tournament games by at least 13 points, and only the second to hold six straight tournament opponents under 40 percent shooting.
These six wins began a 12-game NCAA tournament streak, through the 2024 title game, in which UConn never won by fewer than 13 points.
